policy: The v1.5.0 contract is frozen: each active source's URL building, list parsing and JD fetch live in jobs_scraper/sources/<source>.py, and sg_product_jobs.py keeps only thin wrappers over them — one implementation per behaviour, verified by AST. The active CLI sources are linkedin, jobstreet, cake and 104/onezerofour; jora stays retired from active crawling and is kept only for back-compat dedup of historical rows. The engine's title filter, Sheet write order, cross-source identity, work-mode values, retry ladders and single-source-of-truth crawl state are unchanged by the split; future source expansion or retirement requires an explicit authorized contract change.
